test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I have no objection ________ your proposal.
solution:
The correct answer is '**to**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**to**" is used to indicate direction, purpose, or relation in this context.
 
• The phrase "no objection to" is a commonly used construction in English to express agreement or lack of opposition to something.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** are grammatically incorrect in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I have no objection **to**__ your proposal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "for"** is incorrect because "objection for" is not a valid construction in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "of"** is incorrect because "objection of" does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 3: "with"** is incorrect because "objection with" is not a proper English phrase.
